**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The agreement imposes no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Clear Capital, satisfying the rule's **preferred** position. Two provisions were reviewed and cleared:

- **§ 13 (p0047)** — mutual, employee-only non-solicit (term + 1 year, limited to personnel with direct Services involvement). A hiring restraint, not a restraint on our business or products, and it binds RadialSpark equally. Any concern here belongs to the non-solicit rule, not this one.
- **§ 4 (p0020)** — bars Company from reselling or otherwise using Contractor's pre-existing proprietary materials outside the software received. This is scope-of-license/background-IP protection, not a field-of-use restriction on our own or third-party products.

Nothing in §§ 1, 2 or 6 restricts our ability to build competing functionality internally, retain other vendors, or make acquisitions.
